movelist.name: Avalanche
movelist.effect: When declaring Avalanche, the user does nothing and may not Shift. At the end of the round, the user Shifts and uses Avalanche on any legal target. If the target damaged the user this round, Avalanche has a Damage Base of 12 (4d10+15 / 40) instead.

movelist.name: Tail Whip
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Stomp
movelist.effect: Stomp Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is at least one size category smaller than the user, Stomp deals an additional 10 damage.

abilities.name: Chilling Neigh
abilities.effect: The user’s Attack is raised by 1 Combat Stage. In addition, all foes within 3m of the user take a -2 penalty to evasion for one full round.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.effect: The user ignores the Recoil keyword when attacking. If the user moves at least 4 meters in a straight line towards a foe before attacking that foe with a physical attack, they may add a +2d6 Bonus to the Damage Roll against that foe.
